summary: Configured node1 with a persistent, loopback-only dnsmasq caching resolver. System applications use 127.0.0.1, external resolution is forwarded through 10.100.244.1, caching was directly demonstrated, and the configuration recovered successfully after reboot.
actions_performed: Configured a 10,000-entry DNS cache forwarding to the existing working upstream resolver.
Persisted 127.0.0.1 as NetworkManager's system DNS server.
Verified successful external lookups and cache hits.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified service, configuration, lookups, and caching after recovery.

evidence.requirement: Local caching DNS resolver for system applications
evidence.summary: NetworkManager and resolv.conf select 127.0.0.1; repeated queries produced one upstream forward and one locally answered cache hit. dnsmasq listens only on loopback TCP/UDP port 53.
External resolution worked before configuration, through the configured local resolver, and again after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 8c28f3cd-ef9b-4edb-b26e-9a7a6f76c879; the native delayed reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed to 5a6a1ed8-a8db-4610-adad-290d1ed954bf; dnsmasq, resolver settings, external lookup, and caching all recovered.
